title: The Taj Mahal Cost Him His Hands
description:
A dramatic paper-diorama retelling of Ahmad, the architect placed in charge of building the Taj Mahal—and the brutal price that followed his greatest achievement.

A short story about skill, power, and what happens when being irreplaceable becomes dangerous.
